title: citrus × aurantium var. minutissima
intro: Citrus × aurantium var. minutissima, commonly known as Fingered Citrus, is a variety of bitter orange. It has been used for its potential health benefits, including reducing anxiety and stress due to its anxiolytic and sedative effects. The therapeutic actions of Fingered Citrus are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include limonene, β-sinensal, and citral, that exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. Further research is needed to fully understand the effects of Fingered Citrus, but it has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including insomnia, digestive problems, and immune system dysfunction.
